finding: the blind cells and their count are both recoverable from the observer's own crossings, so no structural prior is needed; but self-knowledge requires coverage - a corpus that never crossed a cell yields a confidently incomplete model (cost 1 of 4) with nothing marking it incomplete
limits: two cells, disjoint, ordered along x, noise-free; a cell never crossed is invisible by construction (that is P4, not a bug); count recovered from x-clustering only
